seoTitle: Yellowjackets Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Yellowjackets test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Shauna, Taissa, Natalie, Misty, Lottie, Jackie or Van — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the quiet one with a dangerous edge, the competitor, or the wild card nobody saw coming? Answer 12 everyday questions about friendship, survival and secrets, and find out which Yellowjackets character you are.

characters.name: Shauna Shipman
characters.title: The Quiet One
characters.summary: Quiet, overlooked and far more dangerous than anyone realises. You've spent years in someone else's shadow.
description: Like Shauna, you're the one people overlook. As a teenager, she was best friends with Jackie, the team captain.
You keep big secrets. Shauna was secretly pregnant by Jackie's boyfriend, Jeff, and it tore their friendship apart.
You're stronger than you look. As an adult, Shauna is married to Jeff with a teenage daughter, and still haunted by what happened in the wilderness.
characters.flaw: You bottle everything up until it comes out all at once.
characters.signature: A quiet smile, a sharp mind and a lot of resentment.
characters.clashReason: they'd smile at you and quietly resent you for years

characters.name: Taissa Turner
characters.title: The Competitor
characters.summary: Driven, ambitious and a natural leader. You'll do whatever it takes to win, and to keep everyone alive.
description: Like Taissa, you're built to compete. She was a star of the soccer team, and after the crash she emerges as a natural leader.
You aim high. As an adult, Taissa runs for the New Jersey Senate.
But you have a darker side. In the wilderness, Taissa suffers strange blackouts, and they follow her into adult life.
characters.flaw: You'd sacrifice almost anything to win, and sometimes you do.
characters.signature: Muddy soccer cleats, a campaign poster and a side of you nobody's met.
characters.clashReason: they'd treat everything as a competition, including you

characters.name: Natalie Scatorccio
characters.title: The Rebel
characters.summary: Tough, blunt and nobody's fool. You've got a rebellious streak, and a heart you don't show off.
description: Like Natalie, you do things your own way. She's the rebel of the team, volatile and never afraid to speak her mind.
You see through people. In the wilderness, Natalie often clashes with Lottie and refuses to just go along with the group.
You've had a hard road. As an adult, Natalie has been in and out of rehab, but she's still fiercely loyal to the people who matter.
characters.flaw: You're harder on yourself than anyone else ever could be.
characters.signature: A leather jacket, a cassette tape and a very short temper.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you exactly where to go

characters.name: Misty Quigley
characters.title: The Wild Card
characters.summary: Eager, clever and a little bit terrifying. You want to be needed, and you'll make sure you are.
description: Like Misty, you've been underestimated your whole life. She was the team's nerdy equipment manager, and the players often bullied her.
Then you become essential. After the crash, Misty's first aid skills make her one of the most valuable people in the group.
You're a lot more than you seem. As an adult, Misty works in a nursing home and moonlights as a citizen detective, and she's genuinely unsettling.
characters.flaw: You'll do things nobody else would, just to be needed.
characters.signature: A first aid kit, a true-crime habit and a smile that's slightly too wide.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep you close in a way that's honestly a bit scary

characters.name: Lottie Matthews
characters.title: The Visionary
characters.summary: Calm, intense and deeply spiritual. You sense things other people miss, and people follow you because of it.
description: Like Lottie, you see the world differently. She's prone to strange visions and prophecies, and nobody knows quite what to make of them.
You become a leader without trying. In the wilderness, Lottie's influence grows until much of the group follows her.
You've been through a lot. As an adult, Lottie leads a mysterious group of her own.
characters.flaw: You believe so completely that it can lead people somewhere dark.
characters.signature: A calm voice, a strange feeling and a following you never asked for.
characters.clashReason: they'd find deep meaning in everything, even your bad day

characters.name: Jackie Taylor
characters.title: The Captain
characters.summary: Popular, warm and used to everything going your way. You want everyone to get along, and everyone to like you.
description: Like Jackie, you're the one everyone looks up to. She's the team captain and the most popular girl at school.
You keep the peace. Jackie wants everyone to be friends, and she hates conflict.
But you struggle when the rules change. After the crash, Jackie's popularity counts for nothing, and she doesn't pull her weight.
characters.flaw: You'd rather be liked than be useful.
characters.signature: A captain's smile, a perfect ponytail and a boyfriend everyone envies.
characters.clashReason: they'd want everyone to get along, even when someone's clearly in the wrong

characters.name: Van Palmer
characters.title: The Loyal One
characters.summary: Tough, warm and loyal to the end. You'd follow the people you love anywhere, and you'd make them laugh on the way.
description: Like Van, you're the friend everyone wants on their side. She's one of the team, and Taissa's girlfriend.
You're tougher than anyone. Van is seriously injured in the wilderness, and survives it.
You're loyal to your core. Van and Taissa come out as a couple, and her loyalty to the people she loves never wavers.
characters.flaw: You follow the people you love even when they're heading somewhere bad.
characters.signature: A battle scar and a terrible joke for a terrible moment.
characters.clashReason: they'd follow someone else's lead even when it's clearly a bad idea

questions.text: Your friends are planning a camping trip. You...

options.text: Pack a full first aid kit. You're ready for anything
Bring the snacks and the good vibes, but forget the tent
Pack the music, and something you're definitely not supposed to
Plan the route, and make sure you get there first

questions.text: Your best friend gets something you've always wanted. You...

options.text: Congratulate them, then quietly resent it for years
Assume it'll come to you too. It usually does
Work twice as hard, so next time it's yours
Be genuinely happy for them

questions.text: You're put in charge of a group project. You...

options.text: Set the targets and push everyone to win
Volunteer to do everything, then remind everyone you did
Make sure everyone gets along, even if nothing gets done
Do your part, and call out anyone who isn't doing theirs

questions.text: Someone in your group starts acting really strangely. You...

options.text: Wonder if it's a sign. Something bigger is going on
Start a case file. You love a mystery
Ask them straight out what's going on
Watch them quietly, and keep your thoughts to yourself

questions.text: You're stuck somewhere with no phone signal for a whole week. You...

options.text: Find peace. Maybe this was meant to happen
Make the best of it. At least the company's good
Panic. How is anyone supposed to live like this?
Start walking. You'll find a signal before anyone else does
Smile sweetly, and make them regret it later
Let them. They'll find out what you're capable of soon enough
Tell them exactly where they can go
Shrug. They'll work it out eventually

questions.text: Your friends are fighting, and it's getting nasty. You...

options.text: Try to make everyone friends again
Calm everyone down and bring them back together
Crack a joke to break the tension
Stay out of it, but remember everything

questions.text: You make a big mistake that hurts someone. You...

options.text: Beat yourself up about it for years
Never tell anyone, and carry it alone
Find a way to make it look like someone else's fault
Push it out of your mind and keep moving

questions.text: You meet someone who believes in something you really don't. You...

options.text: Gently show them a different way of seeing things
Say flat out that you think it's nonsense
Respect it, as long as they don't push it on you
Agree with them, so things don't get awkward

questions.text: You get one big shot at something you've always wanted. You...

options.text: Go for it, and let nothing get in your way
Hesitate, then grab it before anyone else can
Make sure everyone knows how much you deserve it
Take it, and bring your friends along for the ride

questions.text: Your team's plane crashes in the wilderness, and nobody's coming to rescue you. You...

options.text: Take charge. Someone has to keep everyone alive
Feel a tiny thrill. For once, they really need you
Refuse to believe it. Someone will come for you
Listen to the wilderness. It's trying to tell you something

questions.text: You survived something terrible with your friends, and you all swore never to talk about it. Years later, someone starts sending threats. You...

options.text: Go after whoever's doing it, yourself
Stay calm, and protect your family whatever it takes
Investigate. This is the most exciting thing in years
Feel it in your bones. It isn't over yet
